chitchat: "Blue pages by four. I don't care whose name is on the card."
Priya thumbs her headset and reads a line back to herself, mouthing it flat to see if it survives.
description: A brisk woman in a studio blazer the exact violet of the KSAB logo, headset cocked over one ear, a red grease pencil holstered where a weapon would go on anyone else. She reads the board the way a mechanic reads an engine, and she has cut better lines than yours out of better writers than you without changing her expression.

bye.text: "Mind the cards." She's already back at the board, moving an act break two inches left.

options.label: So can I write for you?

job.text: "Script coordinator. Means I lock the pages, I chase the drafts, and when the show goes out wrong at eleven it's my colour on the last version anybody touched." She taps the grease pencil against the board. "Everyone in here thinks they're a writer. Somebody has to be the deadline."

hire.text: "Bring me pages, not a pitch." She doesn't look up. "The room's full of people who can describe a joke. Down the block at the Deadline there's a booth full of people who can't stop writing them, and half of those are here by morning. Go be one of those."

options.label: What do you actually do here?

root.text: "If you're not carrying pages, don't stand in front of the board." Priya's eyes flick from your shoes to your face and back, pricing you. "Script locks at four. There's coffee and there's whatever's left of the cart — that's the whole hospitality budget, so take it seriously."

story.text: "Three acts, two of them work." She waves the pencil at the corkboard without turning. "We've rewritten the cold open four times because someone upstairs decided the audience needs to be told what they're feeling. It's a card that says FIX THE ENDING and it has been that card since the spring."

clothing_layers: a sharp KSAB-violet blazer with a laminated ALL-ACCESS lanyard
a pressed white shirt, cuffs grey with pencil, top button undone
sensible flats and a lace bra and panties

name: Priya Vantz
